item.description: Here you can create the content that will be used within the tooltip.
item.label: Body

arrowColor.description: Choose the fill color for the tooltip arrow. By default this matches the module background color.
arrowColor.label: Tooltip Arrow Color

arrowOffset.description: Slide the arrow along the edge that faces the target.
arrowOffset.label: Tooltip Arrow Position

arrowPlacement.description: Choose which tooltip edge shows the arrow and where it sits along that edge (outer ring).
arrowPlacement.label: Tooltip Arrow Placement

arrowSize.description: Control how large the arrow appears.
arrowSize.label: Tooltip Arrow Size

closeDelay.description: Delay before the tooltip closes (mainly for hover).
closeDelay.label: Tooltip Close Delay

distance.description: Gap from the target along the placement direction (main-axis offset).
distance.label: Tooltip Distance

positionMode.description: Anchored keeps the tooltip fixed relative to the target. Follow cursor moves it with the pointer while open.
positionMode.label: Tooltip Movement

showArrow.description: Display a small pointer toward the parent module.
showArrow.label: Show Tooltip Arrow

skid.description: Shifts the tooltip along the target edge (cross-axis offset from the placement).
skid.label: Tooltip Skid

tooltipPlacementGrid.description: Inner grid keeps the tooltip within the target; outer ring places it outside. This sets placement, inside/outside bounds, and edge alignment.
tooltipPlacementGrid.label: Tooltip Position

trigger.description: Choose when the tooltip is shown to visitors.
trigger.label: Show Tooltip On

module.description: Floating info box that appears on hover, click, or focus to reveal extra content.
module.name: divi/tooltip
module.title: Tooltip
